text: そしたら　このへんを　バイクで　かっこよく　とばしてる　とこ　てめーらにも　みせて　やるよ！

structure.jp: このへんを　バイクで　かっこよく　とばしてる　とこ
structure.en: us tearing around here looking cool on our bikes

patterns.name: 〜てやる
patterns.explanation: やる after a て-form verb means doing something for someone, said from above in a rough or cocky way. みせて やる = 'we'll show you (lucky you)'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: このへんを　バイクで　かっこよく　とばしてる　とこ
patterns.explanation: The whole phrase before とこ (short for ところ, 'scene, moment') describes it, like 'the scene where ...' in English. このへんを バイクで かっこよく とばしてる とこ = 'the sight of us tearing around here coolly on bikes'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says the action is going on; in casual speech the い drops and it becomes てる. とばしてる = 'are speeding along'.
